# ai-ready-repo

> A repository-readiness toolkit with executable reference examples. Moves rules into executable structure so there is less to explain in instruction files. Verification-first: every rule has a firing condition that proves the gate works.

The template provides pinned toolchains, one-command bootstrap, import boundary enforcement, ADR validation with firing and retirement conditions, verification drills, a fixture catalog, and verification regression tasks. The Python ecosystem is fully implemented. CDK TypeScript and Terraform are scaffolded with the same patterns.

Key principle: every rule that can be enforced by a tool should be enforced by a tool. AGENTS.md documents only what the tools cannot check.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, quick start, features table, project structure
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Agent guidance — commands, non-obvious constraints, completion evidence rules
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution workflow, review requirements, and links to the backlog
- [Adoption guide](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/docs/adoption.md): Step-by-step guide for adopting the pattern in existing repositories
- [Ecosystems roadmap](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/docs/ECOSYSTEMS.md): 12 ecosystems with pattern mapping table
- [Fixture catalog](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/docs/FIXTURES.md): 8 verification fixture types with attribution

- [Backlog](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/docs/backlog.md): Stable contribution item IDs and current status

## Architecture

- [ADR-ARCH-001: Three-layer architecture](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/docs/adr/ADR-ARCH-001-three-layer-architecture.md): Domain/application/infrastructure boundaries enforced by import-linter
- [ADR-DOMAIN-001: Order state machine](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/docs/adr/ADR-DOMAIN-001-order-state-machine.md): State transitions as the domain example with drill

## Ecosystems

- [CDK TypeScript](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/tree/main/ecosystems/cdk-typescript): AWS CDK v2, jest, cdk-nag, ADR-CDK-001
- [Terraform](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/tree/main/ecosystems/terraform): tflint, checkov, module boundary enforcement, ADR-TF-001

## Scripts

- [AI readiness audit](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/scripts/ai_readiness_audit.py): Read-only configuration inventory; presence is not execution evidence
- [Tool bridges](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/scripts/setup_tool_bridges.sh): Generate config for Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Aider, Gemini, Windsurf
- [ADR validator](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/scripts/validate_adrs.py): Checks ADR format in CI
- [Eval runner](https://github.com/vidanov/ai-ready-repo/blob/main/scripts/run_evals.py): Verification regression checks with baseline tracking; does not run agents
